title: Brass band parades and dances as a teenager
summary: His parents limited his outings; he admired Pichon and Desvigne's bands at dances from age fifteen.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: When you were a kid, did you ever follow the brass band parades around here?
Well, my parents didn't allow me to do much of that. You didn't get out much of the speech either.
I know some kids did and others didn't. I just wondered. Uh-huh.
Well, I was quite young when I was 17 years old. Yeah, that's right.
You were, from the date you gave me, I thought you must be very young.

Right. And I couldn't do much of that before. I went to a few dances. Uh, I used to admire Pichon and, uh, the Senn and Desvien. Uh, they used to let me go to dances after I got around the age of fifteen, sixteen years old. So, I had to be at home at a certain time.
